item.title: Data-Intelligence-Driven Collaborative Management of Low-Altitude Safety and Operations
item.content:encoded:
This special issue seeks research on the integration of data analytics and intelligent technologies to enhance safety and operational coordination in low-altitude airspace. The focus is on how collaborative frameworks can leverage modern computational and information systems to address challenges in managing increasing air traffic at lower altitudes.

Contributions are welcome from researchers and practitioners interested in the intersection of data science, artificial intelligence, and aviation management, particularly regarding the coordination of multiple stakeholders in low-altitude operations.

Appel publié par Transport Policy. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Low-altitude safety
  • Collaborative management
  • Data-driven approaches
  • Intelligence systems
  • Transport operations
